tiers.direct: Answer one local question with the minimum sufficient evidence and relevant limitations.
tiers.brief: Resolve a focused chain of related questions, its drivers, constraints and verification signals.
tiers.full: Resolve coupled judgments, cross-object comparisons or scenarios with comparable evidence, alternatives and falsification.

time_mode.description: Daily pre/post session; intraday/range/nontrading tasks retain honest task state rather than forcing a completed close.

scope.description: Whole specified market or user-selected sectors/themes/assets/companies; independent of depth and delivery.
